No listed German corporate/trust-services provider found. German listed insurance brokers/pools are JDC, Netfonds (now Warburg Pincus), MLP, Hypoport (platforms) and OVB (tied distribution).
_meta.limitations: Ownership for several context names (Patrizia, Oekoworld, MLP, Baader, Multitude, Mediclin, Atoss, secunet) not verified and written as null with a note. Net debt figures from stockanalysis include IFRS16 leases unless stated. EQS, Vectron and Synlab precedents are from memory and flagged low confidence.

Scale segment: no WpUeG mandatory-offer regime applies in the Open Market, which eases a negotiated stake build but squeeze-out still needs 95% (AktG) or 90% (merger squeeze-out). Leverage moderate.
